title: Sprint V2-5: marks u32 + формула 1 coin/hour
brief: Снизить тип Account.marks с u128 до u32; нормализовать формулу начисления: matured = (staked / 1_000_000) * hours (1 целый PWM = 1 mark/hour). CLAIM_ALL = u32::MAX. Обновить RFC, API, клиенты, тесты. Snapshot migration: divide by 1_000_000, saturate to u32::MAX.

decisions.rationale: Agreed by owner 2026-05-06: hyperinflation via raw-unit formula eliminated; u32 cap for per-address marks acts as policy saturation; GPU/CUDA native; reduced RPC payload.
